## Chapter 1 — Talking like a friend

*Talking like a friend*

10 lessons · 103 words · 34 phrases

### 103. The form you have been reading

**Lesson 1 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Recognise the plain form of any verb you know, and say which register you are in
**Grammar:** `dictionary form = plain non-past` — The form on every verb card is a tense — the casual twin of ます.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 書く | かく | to write |
| 待つ | まつ | to wait |
| 飲む | のむ | to drink |
| 帰る | かえる | to return home |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| する | する | to do |
| 来る | くる | to come |

- 毎日コーヒーを飲む。 — I drink coffee every day.
- 明日、映画を見る。 — I'm going to see a film tomorrow.

### 104. Saying you don't, the easy half

**Lesson 2 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Say you do not do something, casually, with ichidan verbs
**Grammar:** `る → ない` — An ichidan verb drops る and adds ない. する → しない, 来る → こない.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 寝る | ねる | to sleep |
| 起きる | おきる | to wake up, to get up |
| 忘れる | わすれる | to forget, to leave behind |
| 覚える | おぼえる | to memorise, to remember |
| 出る | でる | to leave, to exit |
| する | する | to do |
| 来る | くる | to come |

- 今日は出かけない。 — I'm not going out today.
- 朝ご飯は食べない。 — I don't eat breakfast.
- 日曜日は何もしない。 — I don't do anything on Sundays.

### 105. Saying you don't, the rest

**Lesson 3 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Say you do not do something, casually, with any verb
**Grammar:** `godan → あ row + ない` — One rule for all eight endings — く→かない, む→まない. う→わない, and ある→ない.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 書く | かく | to write |
| 急ぐ | いそぐ | to hurry |
| 話す | はなす | to speak, to talk |
| 待つ | まつ | to wait |
| 死ぬ | しぬ | to die |
| 呼ぶ | よぶ | to call, to summon |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 帰る | かえる | to return home |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |
| 走る | はしる | to run |

- コーヒーは飲まない。 — I don't drink coffee.
- 今日は何も買わない。 — I'm not buying anything today.
- 時間がない。 — I don't have time.
- 明日は会社に行かない。 — I'm not going to work tomorrow.

### 106. Saying you didn't

**Lesson 4 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Say what you did not do, casually
**Grammar:** `ない → なかった` — ない is an i-adjective, so the plain past is the かった rule you already have.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| わかる | わかる | to understand |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |
| する | する | to do |
| 高い | たかい | expensive, tall, high |
| 寒い | さむい | cold (weather) |

- 昨日は何も食べなかった。 — I didn't eat anything yesterday.
- 去年は日本に行かなかった。 — I didn't go to Japan last year.
- お金がなかった。 — I didn't have any money.

### 107. Saying you did

**Lesson 5 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Say what you did, casually, with any verb
**Grammar:** `て → た` — The plain past is the te-form with て swapped for た, で for だ.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 書く | かく | to write |
| 泳ぐ | およぐ | to swim |
| 待つ | まつ | to wait |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| 取る | とる | to take, to pick up |
| 飲む | のむ | to drink |
| 呼ぶ | よぶ | to call, to summon |
| 死ぬ | しぬ | to die |
| 話す | はなす | to speak, to talk |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| する | する | to do |
| 来る | くる | to come |

- 昨夜本を読んだ。 — I read a book last night.
- 友達に会った。 — I met a friend.
- 映画を見た。 — I watched a film.
- 学校に行った。 — I went to school.

### 108. Sentences without です

**Lesson 6 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Say what something is, casually
**Grammar:** `です → だ` — The plain copula. だった, じゃない, じゃなかった — and never after an i-adjective.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 学生 | がくせい | student |
| 先生 | せんせい | teacher |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 日本 | にほん | Japan |
| 元気 | げんき | healthy, energetic, fine |
| 暇 | ひま | free, not busy |
| 有名 | ゆうめい | famous, well-known |
| 静か | しずか | quiet |
| 高い | たかい | expensive, tall, high |
| 面白い | おもしろい | interesting, funny |
| 寒い | さむい | cold (weather) |

- 私は学生だ。 — I'm a student.
- ここは静かだ。 — It's quiet here.
- 昨日は暇だった。 — I was free yesterday.
- あの人は先生じゃない。 — That person isn't a teacher.

### 109. Talking like a friend

**Lesson 7 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Hold a short casual exchange without ます or です
**Grammar:** `うん／ううん` — The casual yes and no. A plain question drops か and rises instead.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| うん | うん | yes (casual) |
| ううん | ううん | no (casual) |
| はい | はい | yes |
| いいえ | いいえ | no |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 先生 | せんせい | teacher |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |

- 今日、忙しい？ — Busy today?
- うん、わかった。 — Yeah, got it.
- ううん、行かない。 — No, I'm not going.
- 明日、友達に会う。 — I'm meeting a friend tomorrow.

### 110. Things you have done

**Lesson 8 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Say whether you have ever done something
**Grammar:** `～たことがある` — Have ever done it — an experience, not an event that happened.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| こと | こと | thing, matter |
| 一度 | いちど | once, one time |
| 回 | かい | times (counter for occurrences) |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| 登る | のぼる | to climb |
| 泳ぐ | およぐ | to swim |
| 日本 | にほん | Japan |
| すし | すし | sushi |
| 映画 | えいが | film, movie |
| 山 | やま | mountain |
| 海 | うみ | sea, ocean |
| 旅行 | りょこう | trip, travel |

- 日本に一度行ったことがあります。 — I have been to Japan once.
- 海で泳いだことがない。 — I have never swum in the sea.
- すしを食べたことがありますか。 — Have you ever eaten sushi?
- 山に二回登ったことがあります。 — I have climbed the mountain twice.

### 111. Doing this and that

**Lesson 9 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** List a couple of things you do, without listing all of them
**Grammar:** `～たり～たり + する` — Some of the things you do, not all of them and not in order. It ends in する.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 音楽 | おんがく | music |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 書く | かく | to write |
| 洗う | あらう | to wash |
| 休む | やすむ | to rest, to take a day off |
| 遊ぶ | あそぶ | to play, to spend time enjoyably |
| 歌う | うたう | to sing |
| 聞く | きく | to listen, to ask |
| 買い物 | かいもの | shopping |
| 料理 | りょうり | cooking, cuisine, a dish |
| 仕事 | しごと | work, job |

- 日曜日は本を読んだり音楽を聞いたりします。 — On Sundays I read, listen to music, that sort of thing.
- 土曜日は買い物をしたり料理をしたりします。 — On Saturdays I shop, cook, that sort of thing.
- 友達と遊んだり映画を見たりしますか。 — Do you see friends, watch films, that sort of thing?

### 112. Asking someone not to

**Lesson 10 of 10** · Talking like a friend
**Can do:** Ask someone not to do something
**Grammar:** `～ないでください` — Please don't — the ない form in the slot where ～てください takes the te-form.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 忘れる | わすれる | to forget, to leave behind |
| 開ける | あける | to open (something) |
| 押す | おす | to push, to press |
| 走る | はしる | to run |
| 入る | はいる | to enter, to go in |
| 消す | けす | to turn off, to erase |
| する | する | to do |

- 窓を開けないでください。 — Please don't open the window.
- 忘れないでください。 — Please don't forget.
- ここで走らないでください。 — Please don't run here.

## Chapter 2 — Giving and receiving

*Giving & receiving*

9 lessons · 83 words · 29 phrases

### 114. Giving something to someone

**Lesson 1 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Say that you give something to someone
**Grammar:** `だれに なにを あげます` — You do the giving, and the gift moves away from you. Write it in kana, not 上げる.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| あげる | あげる | to give (to someone else) |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 妹 | いもうと | my younger sister |
| 弟 | おとうと | my younger brother |
| 子供 | こども | child, children |
| 花 | はな | flower |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| お菓子 | おかし | sweets, snacks |
| 靴下 | くつした | socks |
| 誕生日 | たんじょうび | birthday |

- 友達に花をあげました。 — I gave a friend flowers.
- 妹にお菓子をあげます。 — I'll give my little sister some sweets.
- 誕生日に何をあげますか。 — What are you going to give for the birthday?

### 115. Receiving something from someone

**Lesson 2 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Say that you received something from someone
**Grammar:** `だれから／だれに なにを もらいます` — You do the receiving. The person it came from takes から or に.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| もらう | もらう | to receive, to get |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 母 | はは | my mother |
| 誰 | だれ | who |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 誕生日 | たんじょうび | birthday |
| お金 | おかね | money |

- 誕生日に友達から本をもらいました。 — I got a book from a friend for my birthday.
- 母にお金をもらいました。 — I got some money from my mother.
- 誰からもらいましたか。 — Who did you get it from?

### 116. When someone gives it to you

**Lesson 3 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Say that someone gave you something
**Grammar:** `だれが なにを くれます` — Someone else gives, and it lands on you. The subject is no longer you.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| くれる | くれる | to give (to me) |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 母 | はは | my mother |
| 父 | ちち | my father |
| 先生 | せんせい | teacher |
| わたし | わたし | I, me |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 傘 | かさ | umbrella |
| お菓子 | おかし | sweets, snacks |

- 友達が花をくれました。 — A friend gave me flowers.
- 母がお菓子をくれました。 — My mother gave me some sweets.
- 先生が私に傘をくれました。 — My teacher gave me an umbrella.
- 誰がくれましたか。 — Who gave it to you?

### 117. Choosing the right one

**Lesson 4 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Pick the right giving verb for who is on each side of an exchange
**Grammar:** `あげる／もらう／くれる` — The particles say who is on each side. が before the giver means it came to you.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| あげる | あげる | to give (to someone else) |
| もらう | もらう | to receive, to get |
| くれる | くれる | to give (to me) |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 母 | はは | my mother |
| 妹 | いもうと | my younger sister |
| 先生 | せんせい | teacher |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 花 | はな | flower |

- 母に本をあげました。 — I gave my mother a book.
- 母が本をくれました。 — My mother gave me a book.
- 母に本をもらいました。 — I got a book from my mother.

### 118. Not the same as lending

**Lesson 5 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Ask to borrow something without accidentally asking to keep it
**Grammar:** `貸す／借りる／返す ≠ あげる／もらう` — Lending is temporary and giving is not. 貸してください keeps it a loan.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 貸す | かす | to lend |
| 借りる | かりる | to borrow |
| 返す | かえす | to give back, to return something |
| もらう | もらう | to receive, to get |
| 傘 | かさ | umbrella |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| お金 | おかね | money |
| 明日 | あした | tomorrow |

- 傘を貸してください。 — Please lend me an umbrella.
- 傘をください。 — Please give me an umbrella.
- 明日、本を返します。 — I'll give the book back tomorrow.

### 119. Doing something for someone

**Lesson 6 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Offer to do something for someone, as a favour
**Grammar:** `～てあげます` — Doing something for someone as a favour. The same caution as あげる applies.
**New kanji:** 伝

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 手伝う | てつだう | to help, to assist |
| あげる | あげる | to give (to someone else) |
| 教える | おしえる | to teach, to tell |
| 作る | つくる | to make |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| 持つ | もつ | to hold, to carry |
| 宿題 | しゅくだい | homework |
| 英語 | えいご | English (language) |
| お弁当 | おべんとう | boxed lunch |
| 妹 | いもうと | my younger sister |
| 弟 | おとうと | my younger brother |

- 妹の宿題を手伝ってあげました。 — I helped my little sister with her homework.
- 友達に英語を教えてあげました。 — I taught my friend English.
- 弟にお弁当を作ってあげました。 — I made my little brother a boxed lunch.

### 120. When someone does something for you

**Lesson 7 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Say that someone did something for you, as a favour
**Grammar:** `～てくれます` — Someone does it for you, unasked. This is the くれる inside every ください.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| くれる | くれる | to give (to me) |
| 教える | おしえる | to teach, to tell |
| 作る | つくる | to make |
| 貸す | かす | to lend |
| 待つ | まつ | to wait |
| 母 | はは | my mother |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 先生 | せんせい | teacher |
| 傘 | かさ | umbrella |
| お弁当 | おべんとう | boxed lunch |
| 英語 | えいご | English (language) |

- 母がお弁当を作ってくれました。 — My mother made me a boxed lunch.
- 友達が傘を貸してくれました。 — A friend lent me an umbrella.
- 先生が英語を教えてくれました。 — My teacher taught me English.

### 121. Asking for the favour

**Lesson 8 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Ask someone, gently, to do something for you
**Grammar:** `～てくれますか／～てくれませんか` — Asking for the favour. The negative question is the softer of the two.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| くれる | くれる | to give (to me) |
| 手伝う | てつだう | to help, to assist |
| 教える | おしえる | to teach, to tell |
| 作る | つくる | to make |
| 待つ | まつ | to wait |
| 貸す | かす | to lend |
| 傘 | かさ | umbrella |
| 英語 | えいご | English (language) |

- 待ってくれますか。 — Will you wait for me?
- 傘を貸してくれませんか。 — Could you lend me an umbrella?
- 英語を教えてくれませんか。 — Could you teach me English?
- 手伝ってくれますか。 — Will you help me?

### 122. Having someone do it for you

**Lesson 9 of 9** · Giving & receiving
**Can do:** Say that you got someone to do something for you
**Grammar:** `～てもらいます` — You got someone to do it. Your sentence, their action — the giver takes に.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| もらう | もらう | to receive, to get |
| 教える | おしえる | to teach, to tell |
| 作る | つくる | to make |
| 貸す | かす | to lend |
| 先生 | せんせい | teacher |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 母 | はは | my mother |
| 英語 | えいご | English (language) |
| 傘 | かさ | umbrella |
| お弁当 | おべんとう | boxed lunch |

- 先生に英語を教えてもらいました。 — I had my teacher teach me English.
- 友達に傘を貸してもらいました。 — I got a friend to lend me an umbrella.
- 母にお弁当を作ってもらいました。 — I had my mother make me a boxed lunch.

## Chapter 3 — Putting sentences together

*Putting sentences together*

7 lessons · 78 words · 27 phrases

### 124. Saying why, casually

**Lesson 1 of 7** · Putting sentences together
**Can do:** Give a reason for something, the way you would to a friend
**Grammar:** `plain form + から` — Because. Straight onto a verb or an い-adjective; a noun or な-adjective takes だ first.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 疲れる | つかれる | to get tired |
| 寒い | さむい | cold (weather) |
| 忙しい | いそがしい | busy |
| 静か | しずか | quiet |
| 暇 | ひま | free, not busy |
| 学生 | がくせい | student |
| 雨 | あめ | rain |

- 疲れたから、帰る。 — I'm tired, so I'm going home.
- 今日は忙しいから、行かない。 — I'm busy today, so I'm not going.
- 雨だから。 — Because it's raining.

### 125. Saying why, more carefully

**Lesson 2 of 7** · Putting sentences together
**Can do:** Give a reason the softer way — to a stranger, or in an explanation
**Grammar:** `plain form + ので` — The same reason, said more softly — and な where から took だ.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| わかる | わかる | to understand |
| 疲れる | つかれる | to get tired |
| 寒い | さむい | cold (weather) |
| 近い | ちかい | near, close |
| 静か | しずか | quiet |
| 便利 | べんり | convenient, handy |
| 学生 | がくせい | student |
| 病院 | びょういん | hospital |

- 疲れたので、今日は休みます。 — I'm tired, so I'll take today off.
- 駅が近いので、歩きます。 — The station is close, so I'll walk.
- 静かなので、ここが好きです。 — It's quiet, so I like it here.
- 学生なので、お金がありません。 — I'm a student, so I don't have any money.

### 126. Saying "but"

**Lesson 3 of 7** · Putting sentences together
**Can do:** Contradict, soften, or add a complication to what you just said
**Grammar:** `predicate + けど` — But. It attaches to a finished sentence, plain or polite, either way.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 高い | たかい | expensive, tall, high |
| おいしい | おいしい | delicious, tasty |
| 好き | すき | like, favorite |
| わかる | わかる | to understand |
| 難しい | むずかしい | difficult |
| 面白い | おもしろい | interesting, funny |

- この店は高いけど、おいしい。 — This shop is expensive, but the food's good.
- 難しいですけど、面白いです。 — It's difficult, but it's interesting.
- 好きだけど、買わない。 — I like it, but I'm not going to buy it.

### 127. Doing one thing, then another

**Lesson 4 of 7** · Putting sentences together
**Can do:** Describe two things you did, in order, as one sentence
**Grammar:** `て + second verb` — And then. The te-form joining two verbs in the order they happened.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 起きる | おきる | to wake up, to get up |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 寝る | ねる | to sleep |
| 帰る | かえる | to return home |
| 休む | やすむ | to rest, to take a day off |
| 書く | かく | to write |
| 泳ぐ | およぐ | to swim |
| 待つ | まつ | to wait |
| 飲む | のむ | to drink |
| 話す | はなす | to speak, to talk |
| 歩く | あるく | to walk |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 聞く | きく | to listen, to ask |

- 海で泳いで、家に帰った。 — I swam in the sea and went home.
- 駅まで歩いて、電車にのった。 — I walked to the station and got on the train.
- 昨日は本を読んで、音楽を聞いた。 — Yesterday I read a book and then listened to music.
- ご飯を食べて、本を読んだ。 — I ate, and then read a book.

### 128. Doing two things at once

**Lesson 5 of 7** · Putting sentences together
**Can do:** Say you are doing two things simultaneously, as one person
**Grammar:** `ます-stem + ながら` — While. Stop before ます, add ながら — two actions at once, one person doing both.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 歩く | あるく | to walk |
| 話す | はなす | to speak, to talk |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 歌う | うたう | to sing |
| 聞く | きく | to listen, to ask |
| 音楽 | おんがく | music |
| 料理 | りょうり | cooking, cuisine, a dish |

- 駅まで歩きながら話しました。 — We talked while we walked to the station.
- ご飯を食べながら、本を読みます。 — I read a book while I eat.
- 音楽を聞きながら料理をします。 — I cook while listening to music.

### 129. Saying when

**Lesson 6 of 7** · Putting sentences together
**Can do:** Say when something happens or happened, as its own clause
**Grammar:** `plain clause + 時` — When. A whole clause standing in front of an ordinary noun meaning "moment".

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 時 | とき | time, moment, occasion |
| のる | のる | to ride, to board |
| バス | バス | bus |
| 切符 | きっぷ | ticket |
| 着く | つく | to arrive |
| 家 | いえ | house, home |
| 電話 | でんわ | telephone |
| 寒い | さむい | cold (weather) |
| 窓 | まど | window |
| 閉める | しめる | to close (something) |
| 静か | しずか | quiet |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 子供 | こども | child, children |
| 公園 | こうえん | park |
| 遊ぶ | あそぶ | to play, to spend time enjoyably |

- バスにのる時、切符を買います。 — When I get on the bus, I buy a ticket.
- 家に着いた時、電話します。 — When I get home, I'll call.
- 寒い時、窓を閉めます。 — When it's cold, I close the window.
- 静かな時、本を読みます。 — When it's quiet, I read.
- 子供の時、この公園で遊びました。 — When I was a child, I played in this park.

### 130. The book, the person, the place

**Lesson 7 of 7** · Putting sentences together
**Can do:** Understand — and build — a noun described by a whole sentence, not just one word
**Grammar:** `plain clause + any noun` — The book I bought, the person who speaks. The same slot 時 used, with no 時 in it.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| 昨日 | きのう | yesterday |
| 面白い | おもしろい | interesting, funny |
| 人 | ひと | person, people |
| 話す | はなす | to speak, to talk |
| 英語 | えいご | English (language) |
| いる | いる | to exist, to be (animate) |
| 家 | いえ | house, home |
| 住む | すむ | to live, to reside |
| 駅 | えき | station |
| 近い | ちかい | near, close |
| 店 | みせ | shop, store |
| 高い | たかい | expensive, tall, high |
| 教える | おしえる | to teach, to tell |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| 去年 | きょねん | last year |

- 昨日買った本は面白かったです。 — The book I bought yesterday was interesting.
- 英語を話す人はいますか。 — Is there anyone who speaks English?
- 私が住んでいる家は駅から近いです。 — The house I live in is close to the station.
- 高くない店を教えてください。 — Please tell me about a shop that isn't expensive.
- 去年会った友達に電話しました。 — I called the friend I met last year.

### 131. Recognition checkpoint — closes the chapter

The joins are worth watching for as they come round — だから against なので, て against ながら against たり — since the words on either side are ones you already knew and the join is the only new thing in the sentence. Anything you miss comes back sooner. It finishes when the remaining set empties; retry as often as you like, nothing is recorded.

## Chapter 4 — Feeling ill and the doctor

*Feeling ill and the doctor*

7 lessons · 53 words · 25 phrases

### 132. Not feeling well

**Lesson 1 of 7** · Feeling ill and the doctor
**Can do:** Say that you're sick, or that you're fine
**Grammar:** `noun or な-adjective + になる` — Become. The に is what a noun or a な-adjective needs before なる — 病気になる, 元気になる.
**New kanji:** 病

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 病気 | びょうき | illness, sickness |
| 気分 | きぶん | feeling, mood |
| なる | なる | to become |
| 悪い | わるい | bad |
| 元気 | げんき | healthy, energetic, fine |
| 大丈夫 | だいじょうぶ | OK, alright, fine |

- 病気になりました。 — I got sick.
- 気分が悪いです。 — I don't feel well.
- 大丈夫ですか。 — Are you all right?

### 133. Where else it hurts

**Lesson 2 of 7** · Feeling ill and the doctor
**Can do:** Say your stomach or throat hurts
**New kanji:** 腹

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| お腹 | おなか | stomach, belly |
| 喉 | のど | throat |
| 痛い | いたい | painful, sore |
| 頭 | あたま | head |
| 足 | あし | foot, leg |
| 歯 | は | tooth, teeth |
| 体 | からだ | body |

- お腹が痛いです。 — My stomach hurts.
- 喉が痛いです。 — My throat hurts.
- 頭とお腹が痛いです。 — My head and my stomach hurt.

### 134. A fever, and a cold

**Lesson 3 of 7** · Feeling ill and the doctor
**Can do:** Say you have a fever or caught a cold
**New kanji:** 熱 邪

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 熱 | ねつ | fever, temperature |
| 風邪 | かぜ | a cold |
| 風 | かぜ | wind |
| 引く | ひく | to pull |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |

- 熱があります。 — I have a fever.
- 風邪を引きました。 — I caught a cold.
- 熱はありません。 — I don't have a fever.

### 135. A cough, and how long

**Lesson 4 of 7** · Feeling ill and the doctor
**Can do:** Describe a cough, and say how long you've felt this way

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 席 | せき | seat |
| 咳 | せき | cough |
| 出る | でる | to leave, to exit |
| いつ | いつ | when |
| 昨日 | きのう | yesterday |
| 今日 | きょう | today |
| 休む | やすむ | to rest, to take a day off |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 熱 | ねつ | fever, temperature |
| 風邪 | かぜ | a cold |

- 咳が出ます。 — I have a cough.
- いつからですか。 — Since when?
- 昨日から咳が出ます。 — I've had a cough since yesterday.
- 熱があるので、今日は休みます。 — I have a fever, so I'm taking today off.
- 風邪を引いたので、今日は行きません。 — I caught a cold, so I'm not going today.

### 136. What's wrong?

**Lesson 5 of 7** · Feeling ill and the doctor
**Can do:** Understand "what's wrong?" and explain your symptoms
**Grammar:** `どうしましたか` — What's wrong? どう, the past of する, and か — a stock question with no new word in it.
**New kanji:** 医 者

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 医者 | いしゃ | doctor, physician |
| どう | どう | how, in what way |
| する | する | to do |
| 先生 | せんせい | teacher |
| 病院 | びょういん | hospital |
| 来る | くる | to come |
| 気分 | きぶん | feeling, mood |
| お腹 | おなか | stomach, belly |
| 痛い | いたい | painful, sore |
| 熱 | ねつ | fever, temperature |
| 昨日 | きのう | yesterday |

- どうしましたか。 — What's wrong?
- 熱があるので、病院に来ました。 — I have a fever, so I came to the hospital.
- 気分が悪いので、医者に行きます。 — I don't feel well, so I'm going to the doctor.
- 昨日からお腹が痛いです。 — My stomach has hurt since yesterday.

### 137. What the doctor says

**Lesson 6 of 7** · Feeling ill and the doctor
**Can do:** Understand simple instructions, and say you'll book a visit
**New kanji:** 薬

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 薬 | くすり | medicine |
| 休む | やすむ | to rest, to take a day off |
| 飲む | のむ | to drink |
| 予約 | よやく | reservation |
| 電話 | でんわ | telephone |
| する | する | to do |
| 病院 | びょういん | hospital |
| この | この | this (+ noun) |

- 休んでください。 — Please rest.
- この薬を飲んでください。 — Please take this medicine.
- 予約をお願いします。 — I'd like to make an appointment.
- 病院に電話します。 — I'll call the hospital.

### 138. Getting better

**Lesson 7 of 7** · Feeling ill and the doctor
**Can do:** Say you're getting better or worse
**Grammar:** `い-adjective + くなる` — Become, from an adjective. Drop the い and add く — 悪い to 悪くなる, with いい going irregular as よくなる.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| いい | いい | good |
| 悪い | わるい | bad |
| 元気 | げんき | healthy, energetic, fine |
| なる | なる | to become |
| 気分 | きぶん | feeling, mood |
| 少し | すこし | a little, a few |

- 少しよくなりました。 — I'm a little better.
- 気分が悪くなりました。 — I've started feeling worse.
- 元気になりました。 — I'm well again.

## Chapter 5 — Deciding what to do

*Deciding what to do*

8 lessons · 79 words · 28 phrases

### 140. Wanting to do something

**Lesson 1 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Say you want to do something, with any verb
**Grammar:** `ます-stem + たい` — Want to do it. Drop ます, add たい, and the whole thing behaves like an i-adjective.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 食べたい | たべたい | want to eat |
| 飲みたい | のみたい | want to drink |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 飲む | のむ | to drink |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| 泳ぐ | およぐ | to swim |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| する | する | to do |
| 来る | くる | to come |
| 映画 | えいが | film, movie |
| 買い物 | かいもの | shopping |
| 新しい | あたらしい | new |
| 車 | くるま | car |
| 日本 | にほん | Japan |

- 日本に行きたいです。 — I want to go to Japan.
- 映画が見たいです。 — I want to see a film.
- 買い物がしたいです。 — I want to go shopping.
- 新しい車が買いたいです。 — I want to buy a new car.

### 141. Not wanting to, and having wanted to

**Lesson 2 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Say you don't want to do something, or that you did or didn't want to
**Grammar:** `たくない / たかった` — Don't want to, and wanted to — the かった rule you already have from 高かった.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 高い | たかい | expensive, tall, high |
| 昨日 | きのう | yesterday |
| 先週 | せんしゅう | last week |
| 仕事 | しごと | work, job |
| わたし | わたし | I, me |
| 何も | なにも | (not) anything, nothing |
| 映画 | えいが | film, movie |

- 今日は何も食べたくないです。 — I don't want to eat anything today.
- 昨日、映画が見たかったです。 — I wanted to see a film yesterday.
- 私も行きたかったです。 — I wanted to go too.
- 先週は仕事に行きたくなかったです。 — I didn't want to go to work last week.

### 142. Wanting a thing

**Lesson 3 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Say you want something, not to do something
**Grammar:** `noun + がほしい` — Want a thing, not an action. ほしくない, ほしかった — an i-adjective like any other.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ほしい | ほしい | want (a thing) |
| 新しい | あたらしい | new |
| 車 | くるま | car |
| お金 | おかね | money |
| 水 | みず | water |
| 飲む | のむ | to drink |
| 何も | なにも | (not) anything, nothing |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 日本 | にほん | Japan |

- 新しい車がほしいです。 — I want a new car.
- 何もほしくないです。 — I don't want anything.
- 日本に行きたいから、お金がほしいです。 — I want to go to Japan, so I want money.

### 143. Asking what someone wants

**Lesson 4 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Ask a friend what they want to do, or what they want
**Grammar:** `何が + たい / ほしい + か` — Asking what someone wants — the only safe way to talk about another person's wants.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 何 | なに | what |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| ほしい | ほしい | want (a thing) |
| すし | すし | sushi |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |

- 何が食べたいですか。 — What do you want to eat?
- 何がほしいですか。 — What do you want?
- すしが食べたいです。 — I want to eat sushi.

### 144. What you've decided

**Lesson 5 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Say what you plan to do
**Grammar:** `plain non-past + つもりです` — What you have decided to do. A plan, not a want.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| つもり | つもり | intention, plan |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 来年 | らいねん | next year |
| 来週 | らいしゅう | next week |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 日本 | にほん | Japan |
| レストラン | レストラン | restaurant |

- 来年、日本に行くつもりです。 — I'm planning to go to Japan next year.
- 来週、友達に会うつもりです。 — I'm planning to meet a friend next week.
- レストランで食べるつもりです。 — I'm planning to eat at a restaurant.

### 145. Plans that changed

**Lesson 6 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Say you don't plan to do something, or that you had planned to and it changed
**Grammar:** `つもりはない / つもりでした` — No such plan, and a plan that was. つもり is a noun, so both come free.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| つもり | つもり | intention, plan |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 帰る | かえる | to return home |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |
| お金 | おかね | money |
| 時間 | じかん | time, hour |
| 車 | くるま | car |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 昨日 | きのう | yesterday |
| 先週 | せんしゅう | last week |
| 今日 | きょう | today |

- 今日は行くつもりはありません。 — I have no plans to go today.
- 昨日、友達に会うつもりでした。 — I was going to meet a friend yesterday.
- 先週、車を買うつもりでしたけど、買いませんでした。 — I was going to buy a car last week, but I didn't.

### 146. Let's

**Lesson 7 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Propose doing something together
**Grammar:** `ます-stem + ましょう` — Let's. You are proposing and expecting the other person to come along.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 休む | やすむ | to rest, to take a day off |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| する | する | to do |
| 一緒 | いっしょ | together |
| 日曜日 | にちようび | Sunday |
| 今日 | きょう | today |
| もう | もう | already, yet |
| いい | いい | good |

- 一緒に行きましょう。 — Let's go together.
- 日曜日に会いましょう。 — Let's meet on Sunday.
- 今日はもう休みましょう。 — Let's take a break for today.
- いいですね。 — Sounds good.

### 147. Would you like to

**Lesson 8 of 8** · Deciding what to do
**Can do:** Invite someone to do something, more softly than a proposal
**Grammar:** `ます-stem + ませんか` — Would you like to? The same proposal with the answer left open.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 飲む | のむ | to drink |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 映画 | えいが | film, movie |
| お茶 | おちゃ | tea |
| 一緒 | いっしょ | together |
| 日曜日 | にちようび | Sunday |
| 忙しい | いそがしい | busy |

- 一緒に行きませんか。 — Would you like to go together?
- お茶を飲みませんか。 — Would you like some tea?
- 日曜日に映画を見ませんか。 — Would you like to see a film on Sunday?
- すみません、日曜日は忙しいです。 — Sorry, I'm busy on Sunday.

## Chapter 6 — Being able to

*Being able to*

6 lessons · 61 words · 21 phrases

### 149. Saying what you can do, the easy half

**Lesson 1 of 6** · Being able to
**Can do:** Say what you are able to do, for ichidan verbs and the two irregulars
**Grammar:** `ichidan: drop る, add られる` — Able to do it. する has no rule and becomes できる; 来る becomes 来られる, read こられる.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| できる | できる | to be able to, to be good at |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 借りる | かりる | to borrow |
| 覚える | おぼえる | to memorise, to remember |
| 起きる | おきる | to wake up, to get up |
| する | する | to do |
| 来る | くる | to come |
| すし | すし | sushi |
| 買い物 | かいもの | shopping |
| 明日 | あした | tomorrow |
| 今日 | きょう | today |

- 私はすしが食べられます。 — I can eat sushi.
- 今日は買い物ができません。 — I can't go shopping today.
- 明日は来られません。 — I can't come tomorrow.

### 150. Saying what you can do, the rest

**Lesson 2 of 6** · Being able to
**Can do:** Say what you are able to do, with any verb
**Grammar:** `godan: last sound to the え row, add る` — One move for all nine endings — 書ける, 泳げる, 話せる, 待てる, 死ねる, 呼べる, 読める, 買える.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 書く | かく | to write |
| 泳ぐ | およぐ | to swim |
| 話す | はなす | to speak, to talk |
| 待つ | まつ | to wait |
| 死ぬ | しぬ | to die |
| 呼ぶ | よぶ | to call, to summon |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| 帰る | かえる | to return home |
| 走る | はしる | to run |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |
| 切符 | きっぷ | ticket |
| メニュー | メニュー | menu |
| 早い | はやい | early, fast |

- 私は泳げます。 — I can swim.
- 明日、会えますか。 — Can we meet tomorrow?
- 今日は早く帰れません。 — I can't get home early today.
- メニューが読めません。 — I can't read the menu.

### 151. What you can, and can't, do

**Lesson 3 of 6** · Being able to
**Can do:** Talk about ability in a full sentence, marking the thing you can do correctly
**Grammar:** `noun + が + potential` — What you can do takes が, where the plain verb took を.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 話す | はなす | to speak, to talk |
| 英語 | えいご | English (language) |
| 泳ぐ | およぐ | to swim |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 使う | つかう | to use |
| 箸 | はし | chopsticks |
| 少し | すこし | a little, a few |
| ぜんぜん | ぜんぜん | not at all (used with a negative) |
| まだ | まだ | still, not yet |

- 私は英語が少し話せます。 — I can speak a little English.
- 私はぜんぜん泳げません。 — I can't swim at all.
- 英語が話せますか。 — Can you speak English?
- まだ箸が使えません。 — I can't use chopsticks yet.

### 152. Skills without a verb

**Lesson 4 of 6** · Being able to
**Can do:** Say what you are able to do using a noun instead of a verb
**Grammar:** `noun + ができる` — A skill with no verb in the sentence at all. できる sits straight on the noun.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| できる | できる | to be able to, to be good at |
| 英語 | えいご | English (language) |
| 料理 | りょうり | cooking, cuisine, a dish |
| 仕事 | しごと | work, job |
| 買い物 | かいもの | shopping |
| 少し | すこし | a little, a few |
| ぜんぜん | ぜんぜん | not at all (used with a negative) |

- 私は英語が少しできます。 — I know a little English.
- 今日は仕事ができません。 — I can't work today.
- 料理ができますか。 — Can you cook?

### 153. The other way to say it

**Lesson 5 of 6** · Being able to
**Can do:** Say what you are able to do without conjugating the verb at all
**Grammar:** `dictionary form + ことができる` — The same ability, with nothing conjugated. Any verb, no group to sort, and the object keeps を.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| こと | こと | thing, matter |
| できる | できる | to be able to, to be good at |
| 泳ぐ | およぐ | to swim |
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 使う | つかう | to use |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 借りる | かりる | to borrow |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| メニュー | メニュー | menu |

- 私は泳ぐことができます。 — I am able to swim.
- メニューを読むことができません。 — I am not able to read the menu.
- ここで本を借りることができます。 — You can borrow books here.

### 154. Easy to, hard to

**Lesson 6 of 6** · Being able to
**Can do:** Say whether something is easy or difficult to do
**Grammar:** `ます-stem + やすい / にくい` — Easy to, hard to — a claim about the thing, not about you. Both inflect like い-adjectives.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 読む | よむ | to read |
| 本 | ほん | book |
| 使う | つかう | to use |
| かばん | かばん | bag |
| 歩く | あるく | to walk |
| 靴 | くつ | shoes |
| わかる | わかる | to understand |
| 安い | やすい | cheap, inexpensive |

- この靴は歩きやすいです。 — These shoes are easy to walk in.
- このかばんは使いにくいです。 — This bag is hard to use.
- この本は読みやすかったです。 — This book was easy to read.
- この靴は安いです。 — These shoes are cheap.

### 155. Recognition checkpoint — closes the chapter

> A wide pass over everything this chapter has taught. Type the reading or the meaning rather than picking it out of a line-up. One rule for ichidan verbs, one for godan, two ways round the rule entirely with できる and ことができる, and one pair of endings that is not about ability at all — so what is being checked is whether the right one comes to hand for the sentence in front of you, not whether you can recite a table. The が that replaces を is worth watching for. Anything you miss comes back sooner. It finishes when the remaining set empties; retry as often as you like, nothing is recorded.

## Chapter 7 — What people say

*What people are saying*

9 lessons · 50 words · 29 phrases

### 156. What was said

**Lesson 1 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Say what someone else said, in something close to their own words
**Grammar:** `plain clause + と言いました` — と goes straight onto the plain form — no gap, no punctuation, nothing in between.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 言う | いう | to say |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 買う | かう | to buy |
| 寒い | さむい | cold (weather) |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |

- 友達は明日行くと言いました。 — My friend said they're going tomorrow.
- 友達はすしを食べたと言いました。 — My friend said they ate sushi.
- 友達は何も買わないと言いました。 — My friend said they're not buying anything.
- 友達は寒いと言いました。 — My friend said it's cold.

### 157. The word you can't leave out

**Lesson 2 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Report what someone said about who or what something is, without the sentence coming out wrong
**Grammar:** `noun／な-adjective + だ + と` — A noun or な-adjective clause keeps だ in front of と. です never appears there.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 言う | いう | to say |
| 学生 | がくせい | student |
| 大丈夫 | だいじょうぶ | OK, alright, fine |
| 元気 | げんき | healthy, energetic, fine |
| 高い | たかい | expensive, tall, high |
| 好き | すき | like, favorite |

- 友達は学生だと言いました。 — My friend said they're a student.
- 先生は大丈夫だと言いました。 — The teacher said it's fine.
- 友達は元気だったと言いました。 — My friend said they were well.

### 158. What they've been saying

**Lesson 3 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Report what someone has been telling you, the way it is actually said in conversation
**Grammar:** `と言っていました` — What someone has been saying, rather than one thing they said once.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 言う | いう | to say |
| 明日 | あした | tomorrow |
| 仕事 | しごと | work, job |
| 忙しい | いそがしい | busy |
| 旅行 | りょこう | trip, travel |
| 雨 | あめ | rain |

- 友達は明日旅行に行くと言っていました。 — My friend was saying they're going on a trip tomorrow.
- 先生は仕事が忙しいと言っていました。 — The teacher was saying work is busy.
- 友達は今日は来ないと言っていました。 — My friend was saying they're not coming today.
- 母は明日は雨だと言っていました。 — My mother was saying it's going to rain tomorrow.

### 159. They say...

**Lesson 4 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Read a sentence that reports something without naming who said it, and understand what it means

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 言う | いう | to say |
| 有名 | ゆうめい | famous, well-known |

- この山は有名だと言われています。 — This mountain is said to be famous.
- 魚は体にいいと言われています。 — Fish is said to be good for you.

### 160. So I heard

**Lesson 5 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Say what you heard, without saying who told you
**Grammar:** `と聞きました` — What you heard, with no source named — 聞く slots into the same frame 言う did.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 聞く | きく | to listen, to ask |
| 雨 | あめ | rain |
| 天気 | てんき | weather |
| 来週 | らいしゅう | next week |
| 店 | みせ | shop, store |

- 明日は雨だと聞きました。 — I heard it's going to rain tomorrow.
- 先生は来週旅行に行くと聞きました。 — I heard the teacher is going on a trip next week.
- あの店は高いと聞いています。 — I hear that shop is expensive.

### 161. What I think

**Lesson 6 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Say what you think, as an opinion rather than a fact
**Grammar:** `plain clause + と思います` — What you think, marked as your view rather than stated as fact.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 思う | おもう | to think, to believe |
| 高い | たかい | expensive, tall, high |
| 面白い | おもしろい | interesting, funny |
| 好き | すき | like, favorite |
| 有名 | ゆうめい | famous, well-known |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 本 | ほん | book |

- この本は面白いと思います。 — I think this book is interesting.
- 友達はすしが好きだと思います。 — I think my friend likes sushi.
- 友達は明日来ると思います。 — I think my friend will come tomorrow.
- 先生も行くと思います。 — I think the teacher will go too.

### 162. Saying you don't think so

**Lesson 7 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Say you don't think something is true, without producing the sentence English grammar would suggest
**Grammar:** `〜ない + と思います` — The negative usually goes in the clause rather than on 思う. With は, 思いません is normal — そうは思いません.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 思う | おもう | to think, to believe |
| 来る | くる | to come |
| わかる | わかる | to understand |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |
| 時間 | じかん | time, hour |
| 昨日 | きのう | yesterday |

- 友達は英語がわからないと思います。 — I don't think my friend understands.
- 時間がないと思います。 — I don't think there's time.
- 友達は昨日来なかったと思います。 — I don't think my friend came yesterday.

### 163. What I've been thinking

**Lesson 8 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Say what you've been thinking, or that your opinion has held for a while
**Grammar:** `と思っています` — A view you have held for a while, not one you are forming on the spot.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 思う | おもう | to think, to believe |
| 仕事 | しごと | work, job |
| 大丈夫 | だいじょうぶ | OK, alright, fine |
| 元気 | げんき | healthy, energetic, fine |
| 面白い | おもしろい | interesting, funny |

- この仕事は面白いと思っています。 — I think this work is interesting, and have for a while.
- 仕事は大丈夫だと思っていました。 — I thought work was going to be fine.
- 友達は元気だと思っています。 — I believe my friend is doing well.

### 164. Passing it on

**Lesson 9 of 9** · What people are saying
**Can do:** Relay what you heard, then say what you think about it, without mixing the two into one claim
**Grammar:** `〜と言っていました。〜と思います。` — Their words, then yours — attributed separately so neither is mistaken for the other.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 言う | いう | to say |
| 思う | おもう | to think, to believe |
| 聞く | きく | to listen, to ask |
| 明日 | あした | tomorrow |
| 天気 | てんき | weather |
| 忙しい | いそがしい | busy |
| 有名 | ゆうめい | famous, well-known |

- 明日は雨だと聞きましたけど、大丈夫だと思います。 — I heard it's going to rain tomorrow, but I think it'll be fine.
- 友達は忙しいと言っていましたけど、明日は来ると思います。 — My friend said they're busy, but I think they'll come tomorrow.
- 友達はあの店が有名だと言っていましたけど、私は行かないと思います。 — My friend said that shop is famous, but I don't think I'll go.

### 165. Recognition checkpoint — closes the chapter

> A wide pass over everything this chapter has taught. Type the reading or the meaning rather than picking it out of a line-up. The thing to watch as the sentences come round is which verb closes them — 言う and 聞く for what someone else said, 思う for what you think — and whether there is a だ in front of と, since that is the one small word the whole chapter turns on. Anything you miss comes back sooner. It finishes when the remaining set empties; retry as often as you like, nothing is recorded.

*Making plans with friends*

### 166. An arrangement, not just free time

**Lesson 1 of 7** · Making plans with friends
**Can do:** Say you have plans with someone, and that it isn't the same as being free
**New kanji:** 束

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 約束 | やくそく | arrangement, plans with someone |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| 暇 | ひま | free, not busy |
| 忙しい | いそがしい | busy |
| する | する | to do |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |

- 明日は約束がありますか。 — Do you have plans tomorrow?
- 土曜日は約束があるので、暇じゃありません。 — I have plans on Saturday, so I'm not free.

### 167. Would you like to?

**Lesson 2 of 7** · Making plans with friends
**Can do:** Invite a friend to do something, using the safe default register
**Grammar:** `ます-stem + ましょうか` — Shall we? ましょう with か on the end stops assuming the answer and asks for it instead.
**New kanji:** 末

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 週末 | しゅうまつ | weekend |
| 一緒 | いっしょ | together |
| ご飯 | ごはん | rice, meal |
| 食べる | たべる | to eat |
| 会う | あう | to meet |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 何時 | なんじ | what time |
| 何 | なに | what |
| する | する | to do |
| 土曜日 | どようび | Saturday |
| 来週 | らいしゅう | next week |

- 来週の土曜日に会いましょう。 — Let's meet on Saturday next week.
- 何時に会いましょうか。 — What time shall we meet?
- 週末は何をしますか。 — What are you doing this weekend?

### 168. Wanna?

**Lesson 3 of 7** · Making plans with friends
**Can do:** Invite a close friend to do something, casually
**Grammar:** `plain negative + rising ？` — The casual invitation. The ない form asked as a question, with no か and the voice going up.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 見る | みる | to see, to watch |
| 遊ぶ | あそぶ | to play, to spend time enjoyably |

| 一緒 | いっしょ | together |
| 週末 | しゅうまつ | weekend |
| 友達 | ともだち | friend |

- 一緒に行かない？ — Want to go together?
- 映画を見ない？ — Want to see a film?
- 週末、遊ばない？ — Want to hang out this weekend?

### 169. Saying yes, saying no

**Lesson 4 of 7** · Making plans with friends
**Can do:** Accept or decline an invitation, with a reason, in either register

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ちょっと | ちょっと | a little; (trailing off) sorry, no |
| 大丈夫 | だいじょうぶ | OK, alright, fine |

| 忙しい | いそがしい | busy |

| ううん | ううん | no (casual) |

### 170. Does that work for you?

**Lesson 5 of 7** · Making plans with friends
**Can do:** Ask whether a day works, and propose a different one if it doesn't

**Lesson 7 of 7** · Making plans with friends

## Chapter 9 — If and when

*If and when*

### 174. If you have time

**Lesson 1 of 9** · If and when
**Can do:** Say what you'll do if something happens
**Grammar:** `plain past + ら` — If — the plain past plus ら, on verbs, adjectives and nouns alike.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 時間 | じかん | time, hour |
| ある | ある | to exist, to have (inanimate) |
| 行く | いく | to go |
| 安い | やすい | cheap, inexpensive |

| 天気 | てんき | weather |
| いい | いい | good |

- 時間があったら、行きます。 — If I have time, I'll go.
- 安かったら、買います。 — If it's cheap, I'll buy it.
- 学生だったら、安いです。 — If you're a student, it's cheap.

### 175. When you get there

**Lesson 2 of 9** · If and when
**Can do:** Tell someone what to do once something happens, and tell たら's "when" apart from 時
**Grammar:** `～たら (when)` — Once that has happened — and unlike 時, the happening is what makes the rest possible.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 家 | いえ | house, home |
| 帰る | かえる | to return home |
| 電話 | でんわ | telephone |
| する | する | to do |
| 店 | みせ | shop, store |
| 閉まる | しまる | to close (by itself) |
| 駅 | えき | station |
| 着く | つく | to arrive |
| バス | バス | bus |
| のる | のる | to ride, to board |
| 時 | とき | time, moment, occasion |

- 家に帰ったら、電話してください。 — When you get home, please call.
- 店に行ったら、閉まっていました。 — When I went to the shop, it was closed.
- 駅に着いたら、バスにのります。 — When I get to the station, I'll take the bus.

### 176. Press it, and it opens

**Lesson 3 of 9** · If and when
**Can do:** Describe something that always happens as a result of something else
**Grammar:** `dictionary form + と` — Whenever this, automatically that. Never a request or a plan after it.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 押す | おす | to push, to press |
| 開く | あく | to open (by itself) |
| 春 | はる | spring |
| なる | なる | to become |
| 花 | はな | flower |
| 咲く | さく | to bloom, to flower |
| たくさん | たくさん | a lot, many |

| 眠い | ねむい | sleepy |

- 押すと、開きます。 — Press it, and it opens.
- 春になると、花が咲きます。 — When spring comes, the flowers bloom.
- たくさん食べると、眠くなります。 — If you eat a lot, you get sleepy.

### 177. Two ifs that aren't the same

**Lesson 4 of 9** · If and when
**Can do:** Choose between たら and と for a given situation, and say why the other one is wrong

| Word | Reading | Meaning |

| ここ | ここ | here |

| 水 | みず | water |

| 寒い | さむい | cold (weather) |

### 179. If it were

**Lesson 6 of 9** · If and when
**Can do:** Talk about hypothetical situations and general truths
**Grammar:** `い → ければ / noun + なら` — 高ければ, and いい's irregular よければ. Nouns take なら, never ば.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|

- 高ければ、買いません。 — If it's expensive, I won't buy it.

## Chapter 10 — When something goes wrong

*Trouble*

10 lessons · 69 words · 33 phrases

### 184. Saying you're in trouble

**Lesson 1 of 10** · Trouble
**Can do:** Say you're in trouble, and why
**Grammar:** `plain past + から／ので + 困っています` — What went wrong, then the fact that you are stuck. The reason comes first, as it always does in Japanese.

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 困る | こまる | to be in trouble, to be stuck |
| 無くす | なくす | to lose (something) |
| お金 | おかね | money |
| かばん | かばん | bag |

- お金を無くしたので、困っています。 — I've lost my money, so I'm in trouble.
- かばんを無くしたから、困っています。 — I've lost my bag, so I'm in trouble.
- かばんを無くしたから、困っている。 — I've lost my bag, so I'm stuck.

### 185. Losing something

**Lesson 2 of 10** · Trouble
**Can do:** Report that you've lost something
**New kanji:** 財 布

| Word | Reading | Meaning |
|---|---|---|

| 無くす | なくす | to lose (something) |
| かばん | かばん | bag |
| お金 | おかね | money |
| めがね | めがね | glasses |
| 鍵 | かぎ | key |

- 財布を無くしました。 — I've lost my wallet.
- めがねを無くした。 — I've lost my glasses.
- 鍵を無くしましたか。 — Did you lose your key?

## Closing the book

Belongs to no chapter — reviews every situation in the book rather than one chapter's worth.

### 195. Production checkpoint

> The last thing in this book, and the only one that asks you to make a sentence nobody has shown you. Every checkpoint so far has put Japanese in front of you to be recognised, and Book One's last one asked you to write back a phrase you had learned whole. This one is the same shape and a much wider net. You see English and type the Japanese, and what comes up is drawn from the whole of this book rather than one chapter of it — a word from the doctor's chapter, a phrase from making plans, a conditional, whatever you have been taught and have kept. Nothing is prompted with a pattern name. You are simply asked what you would say. Write in kana; you can type romaji and let it convert, but what is checked is the Japanese. Anything you do not get comes straight back, and it ends when there is nothing left to build. There is no score and nothing is recorded — whatever you miss simply returns to your review queue sooner, which is where the work actually gets done.
